TRAINING FRAMEWORK
How the 7-Day Training Works
All selected candidates go through a structured 7-day paid remote training program before being onboarded
to live client operations. Each day has a defined focus area, deliverable, and progress checkpoint. Training
pay is calculated, evaluated, and credited as part of your first month's salary.
Mode
100% Remote — work from anywhere with a stable internet
connection.
Hours
Flexible timing — no fixed clock-in. You own your schedule within the
training window.
City Assignment
Each trainee is assigned a specific city or locality to scrape and
research. This ensures structured coverage and avoids duplication
across the batch.
Compensation
Training pay is evaluated based on progress achieved and credited in
full as part of your first month's salary. No separate disbursement — it
is included in Month 1 payout.
Target
A minimum 60% progress completion is required to be considered for
final onboarding.
Batch Size
20–30 candidates per training cohort.
EVALUATION CRITERIA
Trainees are evaluated on three parameters at the end of the 7-day program:
01
Leads Scraped — Quantity and quality of prospect data collected for the assigned city.
02
CRM Accuracy — Correct formatting and completeness of submitted spreadsheets and CRM
entries.
03
Outreach Attempts — Number of outreach messages sent and responses logged by Day 7.

DAY-BY-DAY SCHEDULE
7-Day Training Calendar
Each day is structured around a specific learning module and a measurable output. Trainees submit daily
progress logs to their assigned supervisor via the shared CRM sheet.
 1
DAY 1
Business Model Deep-Dive
Understanding ProgVision & InstaDemoX
■
Complete walkthrough of ProgVision's service offerings: web development, app development,
cybersecurity audits, and digital marketing.
■
Live demo session of InstaDemoX — understand how it generates websites in 15 seconds using
Google Maps data, real reviews, and WhatsApp integration.
■
Study the pricing tiers (Starter Rs.499/month, Business Rs.999/month, Agency Rs.2,499/month) and
understand how to position each plan to a local business.
■
Read the InstaDemoX FAQ and understand common objections.
 2
DAY 2
Lead Scraping — Foundations
Google Maps & Directory Sources
■
Introduction to lead scraping methodology: what makes a quality lead vs. a dead end.
■
Hands-on scraping exercise using Google Maps for the assigned city — restaurants, salons, hotels,
gyms, and clinics.
■
Learn to extract: business name, owner/manager contact, phone number, WhatsApp availability,
address, Google rating, review count, and website status.
■
Deliverable: Minimum 30 verified leads entered into the shared CRM sheet by end of day.
 3
DAY 3
Multi-Source Lead Collection
JustDial, IndiaMART, Yellow Pages & Social Media
■
Expand lead sourcing beyond Google Maps — JustDial, IndiaMART, Sulekha, Yellow Pages, and
Facebook local business groups.
■
Identify businesses with no website or an outdated/non-mobile website — the primary InstaDemoX
target segment.
■
Cross-reference and de-duplicate across sources for clean data.
■
Deliverable: Add 40 new leads to CRM. Total pipeline: 70+ leads by Day 3.

 4
DAY 4
WhatsApp & Email Outreach
First Contact Messaging & Templates
■
Introduction to outreach scripts approved by ProgVision for InstaDemoX pitch.
■
Understand the difference between cold outreach and warm outreach — tone, timing, and follow-up.
■
Send first batch of WhatsApp messages to scraped leads using approved templates.
■
Log all outreach attempts and responses in the CRM with timestamps.
■
Deliverable: Minimum 20 outreach messages sent and logged by end of day.
 5
DAY 5
Objection Handling & Follow-Up
Converting Responses into Demos
■
Review responses received from Day 4 outreach — categorize by hot, warm, and cold.
■
Study the objection handling guide: price concerns, 'already have a website', 'not interested right now'.
■
Follow up with non-responsive leads. Send demo links from instademox.web.app.
■
Schedule any interested prospects for a live demo call with the ProgVision sales lead.
■
Deliverable: At least 3 demo conversations initiated or 1 meeting scheduled.
 6
DAY 6
Deep Scrape & City Coverage Review
Expanding Coverage Across Your Assigned City
■
Audit your assigned city's coverage — identify uncovered neighbourhoods, markets, or sectors.
■
Focus on high-density commercial areas: local markets, industrial estates, malls, and food streets.
■
Refine your CRM entries — add missing fields, verify phone numbers, and flag priority leads.
■
Deliverable: CRM to contain 100+ leads total with at least 70% fully filled entries.
 7
DAY 7
Review, Submission & Evaluation
Progress Assessment & Onboarding Decision
■
Final review of all CRM data, outreach logs, and pipeline contributions.
■
Submit the completed training report — includes total leads scraped, outreach attempts, responses
received, and meetings scheduled.
■
One-on-one review call with the training supervisor to discuss performance.
■
Candidates achieving 60%+ progress target are confirmed for full onboarding. Training compensation
is credited as part of Month 1 salary.

COMPENSATION & POLICIES
Training Pay, Post-Training Salary & Terms
Training Pay
Evaluated at the end of Day 7 based on performance score. Credited as
part of your first month's salary — not disbursed separately.
Post-Training Salary
Rs. 3,00,000 – Rs. 6,00,000 per annum (Variable Pay, based on
experience and performance after full onboarding).
Payment Cycle
Monthly. First month's salary includes your training compensation.
Minimum Target
60% progress completion across Days 1–7 to qualify for onboarding.
Below 60% Policy
Candidates who do not meet the 60% threshold may be given one
additional week at the supervisor's discretion, or may be released from the
program. Training pay is still credited for work completed.
Work Setup
Remote. No physical office attendance required during training. A laptop or
desktop and stable internet access are mandatory.
City Assignment
Assigned by the ProgVision training coordinator before Day 1. Each trainee
covers a different city or locality to avoid overlap.
NDA & Data Policy
All lead data collected remains property of ProgVision Digital. Trainees
must not share, export, or retain CRM data post-program.
TOOLS & RESOURCES PROVIDED
What ProgVision Gives You on Day 1

Access to the shared Google Sheets CRM template for your assigned city.

Approved WhatsApp outreach message templates (English + regional language variants).

Live access to InstaDemoX (instademox.web.app) for demo generation during pitches.

Onboarding guide PDF with scraping methodology and CRM field definitions.

Assigned supervisor contact for daily check-ins and progress review.

Access to ProgVision's internal knowledge base for product FAQs and objection handling.
